title: Automated identification of ivory carvings using machine learning: A proof-of-concept approach to detecting the illegal wildlife trade
abstract: arXiv:2610.33243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite a ban on the international trading of recently poached ivory, elephants are still killed for their tusks. Ivory and its products are mainly sold in online marketplaces. However, due to the huge volume and variety of adverts and the similarity of ivory with other materials that can be legally sold, it is hard for enforcement officials to identify illicit trading and prosecute sellers. Existing techniques for identifying elephant ivory, such as Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy and microscopy, can reliably distinguish ivory from other materials, but require physical access to the item and cannot be applied to photographs alone. As a result, these methods are unsuitable for screening the large volume of images posted in online marketplaces, leaving a gap for automated, image-based identification tools. translated_title: 利用机器学习自动识别象牙雕刻品：一种检测非法野生动物贸易的概念验证方法
translated_abstract: 尽管国际上禁止交易新近偷猎的象牙，大象仍因象牙而遭到猎杀。象牙及其制品主要通过在线市场进行销售。然而，由于广告数量庞大且种类繁多，以及象牙与其他可合法销售材料的相似性，执法人员难以识别非法交易并起诉卖家。现有的象牙识别技术，如傅里叶变换红外光谱和显微镜检查，虽然能可靠地将象牙与其他材料区分开来，但需要对实物进行物理接触，无法仅凭照片进行识别。因此，这些方法不适用于筛选在线市场上发布的大量图像，这为自动化、基于图像的识别工具留下了空白。在这项概念验证工作中，我们研究了机器学习图像分析技术在自动化识别方面的潜力……
tldr: 本文提出利用机器学习图像分析技术自动识别在线市场图像中的象牙雕刻品，为检测非法野生动物贸易提供了一种概念验证的自动化解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a proof-of-concept machine learning approach to automatically identify ivory carvings from online marketplace images, providing a novel tool for detecting the illegal wildlife trade.
